breakdown.description: Tip boundary condition is inconsistent: an adiabatic tip implies zero heat flux at the tip, so a convective-tip model should not be used.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core inconsistency. The original prompt stated the fin has an adiabatic tip but then incorrectly asked to use a convective-tip formula. The ground truth corrects this by specifying that the adiabatic-tip solution should be used. The agent's generated specification repeated the original error, explicitly instructing to 'Calculate the fin heat transfer rate using the formula for a fin with a convective tip,' which is the wrong approach for an adiabatic tip fin.
